white rice.reason: Replacing part of the rice with a lower-calorie vegetable can reduce total meal calories.

calorie_reduction_options.label: Replace half of the white rice with the same weight of cauliflower.
Reduce the white-rice portion by 25% and add vegetables.

alternatives: plain Greek yogurt in suitable recipes
a light cooking spray where appropriate
butter.reason: Butter is calorie dense, so reducing its amount can meaningfully lower calories.

calorie_reduction_options.label: In a suitable sauce or spread, replace the butter with the same weight of plain Greek yogurt.
Use half as much butter.

cream.reason: Lower-fat dairy or vegetables can reduce calorie density while preserving texture.

calorie_reduction_options.label: Replace cream with the same weight of plain Greek yogurt where suitable.

mayonnaise.reason: These alternatives can substantially reduce calorie density.

calorie_reduction_options.label: Replace mayonnaise with the same weight of plain Greek yogurt.

sour cream.reason: Greek yogurt can provide a creamy texture with fewer calories.

calorie_reduction_options.label: Replace sour cream with the same weight of plain Greek yogurt.

cream cheese.reason: A lower-calorie cheese or smaller portion can reduce calories.

calorie_reduction_options.label: Replace cream cheese with the same weight of cottage cheese.

sugar.reason: Reducing added sugar directly lowers calories.

calorie_reduction_options.label: Use half the amount of added sugar.

fried.reason: These methods generally require less added fat.

calorie_reduction_options.label: Bake, grill, or air-fry with minimal oil instead of deep-frying.
calorie_reduction_options.basis: Exact saving depends on how much frying oil the food absorbs; no fixed calorie number is claimed.

french fries.reason: Using less oil or replacing part of the fries with vegetables can reduce calories.

calorie_reduction_options.label: Use oven-roasted potato wedges with minimal oil, or replace part of the fries with salad.
calorie_reduction_options.basis: The CSV has no exact french-fries profile, so this recommendation is qualitative.

bacon.reason: A leaner replacement can reduce calorie and fat density.

calorie_reduction_options.label: Replace bacon with the same weight of turkey bacon.

sausage.reason: Leaner or plant-based proteins may reduce calories and saturated fat.

calorie_reduction_options.label: Replace sausage with the same weight of lean ground turkey.

white bread.reason: Portion reduction or a vegetable-based wrap can lower total calories.

calorie_reduction_options.label: Use 25% less bread and add a vegetable side.

pasta.reason: Zucchini has a much lower calorie density than pasta.

calorie_reduction_options.label: Replace half of the pasta with the same weight of zucchini.

cheese.reason: A lower-calorie cheese or smaller portion can reduce total calories.

calorie_reduction_options.label: Replace the cheese with the same weight of cottage cheese where suitable.
Use half as much cheese.

coconut milk.reason: Lighter alternatives may reduce total fat and calories.

calorie_reduction_options.label: Use light coconut milk or replace part of it with a lower-fat liquid.
calorie_reduction_options.basis: The uploaded CSV has no coconut-milk profile, so no numeric saving is claimed.

olive oil.reason: Oil is calorie dense even when it has a favorable fat profile.

calorie_reduction_options.label: Use half as much olive oil.

vegetable oil.reason: Reducing added oil can substantially reduce total calories.

calorie_reduction_options.label: Use half as much vegetable oil.

pesto.reason: Tomato-based sauces are typically much less calorie dense.

calorie_reduction_options.label: Replace pesto with the same weight of salsa.

granola.reason: Oatmeal can be substantially less calorie dense than granola.

calorie_reduction_options.label: Replace granola with the same weight of oatmeal.
